what: The rerun kit's manifest: one entry per record the claims register (certs/claims-ledger.json) derives its rows from. For each: the command that re-derives the record from the repository, the standard-library verifier where one exists (python3, no engine code), the independent second implementation where one exists (another author or another arithmetic), and what the commands need. The rows a record decides are read from the register at build and never typed here; the record's sha256 is computed at build. tools/build-report-rerun.js refuses when the register names a record this manifest does not, or the reverse, or when a command names a file that is not on disk. `--run` executes every command, times it, and compares the register's rows before and after (certs/rerun-kit-run.json).

No single command re-derives this record; the lanes' batteries are the re-derivation and the page names them. A kit debt.
